## Principal comparison

The causal ordering is:

`A0 → A0 + wavelet → A0 + wavelet + SSL`.

E1 is reserved for the matched complementarity contrast
`A0+wavelet+SSL` versus `E1+wavelet+SSL`. This prevents architectural changes
from being credited to wavelets or SSL.

## Terminal screening generation and metric availability

```{python}
#| label: wavelet-queue-status
display(queue.status.value_counts(dropna=False).rename_axis("status").reset_index(name="jobs"))
completed = queue.query("status == 'completed'").copy()
metric_cols = [c for c in completed if c.startswith("metric.") and pd.api.types.is_numeric_dtype(completed[c])]
visible = [c for c in ["ordinal", "id", "cell.name", "status", *metric_cols] if c in completed]
display(completed[visible].sort_values("ordinal"))
```

```{python}
#| label: wavelet-reconstruction-delineation-map
if not completed.empty and {"metric.val_missing_pearson", "metric.miou_wave"}.issubset(completed):
    fig = px.scatter(completed, x="metric.val_missing_pearson", y="metric.miou_wave",
                     color="cell.wavelet_bank", symbol="cell.ssl_mode", hover_name="id",
                     hover_data=[c for c in ["metric.P_iou", "metric.QRS_iou", "metric.T_iou",
                                            "metric.boundary_f1_smoke"] if c in completed],
                     title="Reconstruction–delineation trade-off among completed screens")
    fig.update_traces(marker={"size": 10, "opacity": .8})
    fig.show()
```

These are short screening runs unless replicated. The plot shows trade-offs; it
does not provide multiplicity-corrected evidence for the top point.

The exhaustive 115-row metric ledger and five terminal failures are reported in
**Completed One-Lead ECG-AIM Screening Results**. This chapter retains only the
mechanism-focused view; longer-budget outcomes belong to the convergence
chapter and are not pooled into this plot.

## Highest-value physiological contrast

At matched TimeSformer, BYOL objective, optimizer, compute, seed, observed lead,
and fusion, compare:

- Morlet magnitude + Morlet phase
- Morlet magnitude + UEG-repolarization phase

If the second improves primarily T-on and T-off rather than all boundaries, it
supports—without proving—the hypothesis that the physiology of the second SSL
view matters. A generic lift could instead reflect regularization, scaling, or
view difficulty.

## Boundary-localization requirement

RDB supervision provides six real boundary channels: P/QRS/T onset and offset.
It does not provide peaks. Any physiology claim must report channel-level
validity and timing error, not only macro IoU. T-peak must remain absent rather
than being synthesized from an interval midpoint or detector.

## Promotion gate

Promote a configuration only after matched incremental improvement, seed and
lead replication, no reconstruction regression beyond a prespecified margin,
boundary-localized analysis, checkpoint provenance, and blinded LUDB/RDB
evaluation. Otherwise label it exploratory.
